packageRules.description: Hold the interpreter at 3.14: pyroscope-io (kubed-mcp[telemetry], which [test] pulls in) ships no cp315 wheel, and its sdist needs a Rust toolchain, so on 3.15 both `pip install .[test,tasks]` in test.yml and the Dependency Audit's `pip install --editable '.[telemetry]'` in lint.yml fail. Lift this rule once pyroscope-io publishes cp315 wheels, then move lint.yml, package.yml, the test.yml matrix, the pyproject classifiers and spec PKG-8 to 3.15 together.
